name: Mood colour palette planner
why: Plans a palette of five colours or fewer, each with one job, a good start for the main, secondary and accent scheme in the lighting and colour plan.

name: Design brief rules writer
why: Turns a loose request into a brief with a few firm limits, the same first step as the measure-and-brief prompt.

name: Wayfinding sign planner
why: Plans signs a first-time visitor can follow, useful when a new layout changes the route to the counter, toilet or exit.

name: Marketing image prompt writer
why: Writes a single image prompt with size and file name, a partner to the concept image prompts for showing a planned look.

name: Product photo shoot planner
why: Plans matching product photos, the next step after setting up a photo or content corner.

name: Make a readable event poster
why: Builds a window poster whose key facts read from a distance, for the sign spots in a window plan.

name: Type-led poster planner
why: Plans a type-only sign that reads from far away, for windows without good product photos.

name: Prepare a community event access plan
why: Plans access from arrival to exit, a useful check when a shop or cafe rearranges its space for an event.
